meta.name: sql-analysis
meta.description: 读取 SQL 指标说明并执行汇总脚本，输出结构化分析结论。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从SQL指标快速得到分析结论
copy.tagline_en: Run SQL summaries and produce structured analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick analytical conclusions from SQL metrics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先查阅技能自带的指标说明与口径，在用户请求摘要或汇总时运行汇总脚本，必要时继续读取参考资料，最后输出结构化的分析结论。
howto.when: 当用户请求对 SQL 指标进行摘要、汇总或结构化分析时触发。

say.text: 请读取指标说明，汇总本月 SQL 数据。
say.note: 会先读参考资料再执行汇总。

say.text: 对这份 SQL 指标做结构化分析。
帮我执行 summarize 脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first review the metric definitions and calculation rules included in the skill, run the summarize script when the user asks for a summary or aggregate, read additional references if needed, and produce a structured analysis conclusion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a summary, aggregate, or structured analysis of SQL metrics.

say_en.text: Please read the metric definitions and summarize this month's SQL data.
say_en.note: It will read references first, then run the summary.

say_en.text: Provide a structured analysis of these SQL metrics.
